refusal_recall.description: Recall on genuine unanswerable questions (5/5 refused)

refusal_precision.description: Precision of refusals (5 genuine unanswerable out of 11 total refusals)

ndcg_at_10.description: nDCG@10 on relevant documents under deduplicated ranking

cost_per_query_usd.description: Average LLM API cost per query (USD), well within <= 2x baseline ceiling

recovered_questions.explanation: Calibrated completeness rule ensured grace period answer included waiting period continuity.
Strict citation instruction repaired previously missing citation markers, achieving valid citations.
Rule 2 clarified that permanent exclusions (IVF) must be explicitly stated as not covered rather than triggering a false refusal.
Completeness rule ensured incremental sum insured waiting period terms were fully articulated.

regressions.explanation: Document deduplication brought senior-citizen-plan into top 5, causing the generator to quote senior care waiting periods instead of the base policy.
Multi-hop query: missing plans-overview from top-5 context triggered stricter Rule 1 refusal rather than partial answer.
Deduplicating to 1 chunk per document truncated the follow-up post-hospitalisation clause from claims-process, triggering full refusal.
Truncating multi-chunk context removed the newborn vaccination sub-limit, leading the stricter generator to refuse.
Aggregation across all documents: deduplication changed candidate document order, slightly reducing authorisations coverage.

failed_attempt.name: Reflex fix: Wider context (final_k=10) and relaxed prompt refusal rule
failed_attempt.why_it_failed: Relaxing refusal constraints destroyed refusal precision as the model hallucinated answers on Q36/Q38 instead of refusing. Widening context brought in conflicting archived documents on Q29 and introduced excessive distractor tokens that hurt generation accuracy.

post_fix_reclassification.shift_analysis: Fixing generation over-refusals recovered Q05, Q07, Q08, Q21. However, multi-hop questions (Q20, Q26, Q28) regressed into refusals due to single-chunk document truncation, exposing multi-hop retrieval as the true limiting bottleneck.
